name: Universal Store Holdings Limited
summary: Universal Store Holdings Limited engages in the retail operations in the fashion market in Australia. It operates through two segments, Universal Store and Cheap Thrills Cycles. The company offers tops, dresses, skirts, jeans, sherpa, hoodies & jumpers, jackets and coats, shorts, micro shorts, basics, pants, matching sets, T-shirts, knitwear, swim, shirts, jorts, shirts & polos, jerseys, quarter zips, singlets and muscle tanks, and underwear's for men's and women's.
